pneuma:
n. 元氣, 靈魂, 精神
[醫] 氣, 精氣
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">希臘語，意為風、空氣、氣息、精神</dd></dl>
pneumatic:
a. 充氣的, 空氣的, 有氣胎的, 氣動的, 靈魂的
n. 充氣輪胎
a. of or relating to or using air (or a similar gas)

語感
整體中性，偏技術用語；「身材豐滿」義為口語（字典標 informal、US）
詞根詞綴
拉丁 pneumaticus，源自希臘 pneuma「空氣、呼吸、靈魂」
常見搭配
a pneumatic tire；a pneumatic drill；a pneumatic hammer；pneumatic tools
字族
pneumatically (adverb)
pneumatological: a. Of or pertaining to pneumatology.
pneumatology:
n. 靈物學, 聖靈論, 氣體(治療)學
[醫] 氣體[治療]學

n. The doctrine of, or a treatise on, air and other
elastic fluids. See Pneumatics, 1.
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>整體中性；第 4、5 義為古語</dd><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語 pneumatologia，源自 pneumat- ＋ -logia（-logy）</dd></dl>
pneumatolytic: <dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">國際科學詞彙 pneumat- ＋ -lytic</dd></dl>
pneumatophore: n. an air-filled root (submerged or exposed) that can function as a respiratory organ of a marsh or swamp plant
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">國際科學詞彙 pneumat- ＋ -phore</dd></dl>
pneumococcal: a. of or derived from or caused by bacteria of the genus pneumococcus
pneumococcus:
n. 肺炎球菌
[醫] 肺炎球菌屬
n. bacterium causing pneumonia in mice and humans
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語，源自 pneum- ＋ -coccus</dd></dl>
pneumoconiosis:
n. 肺塵埃沉著病, 塵肺
[化] 塵肺病
n. chronic respiratory disease caused by inhaling metallic or mineral particles

<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">pneumoconiosis、pneumokoniosis 源自新拉丁語，源自 pneum- ＋ -coniosis（源自 2coni- ＋ -osis）；pneumonoconiosis、pneumonokoniosis 源自新拉丁語，源自 pneumon- ＋ -coniosis（源自 2coni- ＋ -osis）</dd></dl>
pneumograph:
n. 呼吸描記器
[醫] 呼吸描記器
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">國際科學詞彙 pneum- ＋ -graph</dd></dl>
pneumonectomy:
n. 肺切除術
[醫] 肺切除術
n. surgical removal of a lung (usually to treat lung cancer)
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">國際科學詞彙 pneumon- ＋ -ectomy</dd></dl>
pneumonia: n. respiratory disease characterized by inflammation of the lung parenchyma (excluding the bronchi) with congestion caused by viruses or bacteria or irritants
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，醫學用語</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>現代拉丁語，源自希臘 pneumon「肺」，pneumo- 常用於肺部相關的字</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>catch pneumonia；contract pneumonia；die of pneumonia；double pneumonia</dd></dl>
pneumonic:
a. pertaining to or characterized by or affected by pneumonia
a. relating to or affecting the lungs
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語 pneumonicus，源自希臘語 pneumonikos，源自 pneumon- ＋ -ikos（-ic）</dd></dl>
pneumonitis:
n. 肺炎
[醫] 肺炎, 侷限性肺炎
n. inflammation of the lungs; caused by a virus or an allergic reaction
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語，源自 pneumon- ＋ -itis</dd></dl>
pneumothorax: n. abnormal presence of air in the pleural cavity resulting in the collapse of the lung; may be spontaneous (due to injury to the chest) or induced (as a treatment for tuberculosis)
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語，源自 pneum- ＋ thorax</dd></dl>
png: abbr. 可移植的網路圖象檔案格式（Portable Network Graphic）；（拉）不受歡迎的人（Persona Non Grata）；巴布亞紐幾內亞（Papua New Guina）
pnxt: abbr. pinxit (Latin=he/she painted it) （拉丁語）此畫系某某畫（畫家署名）
